# brand/source-renders/ — the untouched Gemini originals

**All three were generated by Sarwan on Gemini from `ART-DIRECTION.md` prompts.
Nothing here has been edited.** These are the masters of record — if a derived asset
is ever wrong, come back here rather than regenerating and losing the character.

| File | Produced | Became |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-09-13_gemini_avatar_ORIGINAL.png` | Prompt 1, §3 | `../00_MASTER_avatar.png` → `../EXPORT/01_DP_avatar_800.png` |
| `2026-09-13_gemini_stamp_ORIGINAL.png` | Prompt 2, §4 | `../stamp.png` → `../EXPORT/stamp_800.png` |
| `2026-09-13_gemini_banner_ORIGINAL.png` | Prompt 4, §6 | `../EXPORT/banner_2560x1440.png` → `..._FINAL-lora.png` |

**Every derived asset is a mechanical edit of one of these — no redrawing.** What was done:

- **Avatar:** four-pointed sparkle removed (right shoulder) · stray red dot removed from the
  right lens rim, restoring the one-accent rule · background flattened to exact `#1B2A4A` ·
  re-centred and padded to 800×800 so the tuft tips clear YouTube's circle crop
- **Stamp:** cropped tight, quantised to two flat tones, squared to 800×800
- **Banner:** four-pointed sparkle removed (right lapel) · character masked off its
  background to kill a visible rectangular seam · placed on flat `#1B2A4A` at 2560×1440 ·
  two lines of type set

**Recurring generator defect:** it added a four-pointed sparkle to the shoulder in *both*
character renders despite "no sparkles" in the prompt. **Check the shoulders on every
future render.**

**Note:** these three are screenshots rather than original downloads, so they carry a little
app chrome at the edges and are not the generator's native resolution. Good enough as a
reference anchor; if you still have the raw Gemini downloads, they belong here instead.
